examples.arabic: بابا قاله: "يلا يا أحمد، فريقنا هيلعب كويس في المغرب."
examples.english: Dad told him: "Let's go, Ahmed, our team will play well in Morocco."
examples.transliteration: Baba 2al lo: "Yalla ya Ahmad, fari2na hayla3ab kwayes fi el Maghreb."
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: كل واحد في الحتة كان حاسس بفرحة كبيرة عشان الفريق كان بيلعب كويس.
examples.english: Every person in the area was feeling a great joy because the team was playing well.
examples.transliteration: Kol wahed fel hetta kan hases be farha kebira ashan el fariq kan beyelab kways.

examples.arabic: انت عندك حق، الدنيا مش ماشية كويس لما مش بننام.
examples.english: You are right, the world is not going well when we do not sleep.
examples.transliteration: Enta andak hak, el donia mesh mashya kewayyes lamma mesh benenam.

examples.arabic: هو بص كويس وعرف انها اخت صاحبه
examples.english: He looked well and knew that she is his friend's sister.
examples.transliteration: howa bas kwayes we araf enaha okht sahbo.

examples.arabic: انا كنت فاكر انه مصري عشان بيتكلم عربي كويس
examples.english: I thought he was Egyptian because he speaks Arabic well.
examples.transliteration: Ana kont faker inno masry ashan beyetkallem araby kwayyes.

examples.arabic: حاولت أتابع الوصفة كويس بس مش عارف إيه اللي حصل
examples.english: I tried to follow the recipe well but I don't know what happened.
examples.transliteration: Hawwalt atabe' el wasfa kwayyes bas mesh aref eih elli hasal.
